title: Booking an Airbnb and Meeting the Host
meta: B2 · 约 330 词 · 场景：联系民宿房东与入住

lines.en: Hi, is this Daniel? __This is__ Lee. I booked your apartment in Tiong Bahru from Friday to Monday.
lines.zh: 你好，是 Daniel 吗？我是 Lee。我订了你在中峇鲁的公寓，周五住到周一。

lines.en: Hi, Mr. Lee! Thanks for booking. What time are you planning to ==arrive==?
lines.zh: 你好，Lee 先生！谢谢预订。你们打算几点到？

lines.en: **Probably around nine at night. Is it self check-in, or do we need to meet you in person?**
lines.zh: 大概晚上九点左右。是自助入住，还是需要跟你当面碰头？

lines.en: It's self check-in. There's a ==lockbox== by the door, and I'll send you the code on the day.
lines.zh: 是自助入住。门边有个密码钥匙盒，当天我把密码发给你。

lines.en: Great. Is there a ==cot== we could use? We're travelling with a two-year-old.
lines.zh: 好的。有没有婴儿床可以用？我们带着一个两岁的孩子。

lines.en: Yes, there's a baby cot in the storeroom. I'll set it up before you come.
lines.zh: 有的，储物间里有张婴儿床。你们来之前我会装好。

lines.en: That's really helpful. Are there any __house rules__ I should know about?
lines.zh: 太有帮助了。有什么入住规矩我需要知道的吗？

lines.en: Just the usual. No smoking, no parties, and please __keep the noise down__ after ten. The neighbours are quite strict.
lines.zh: 就是常规那些。不能抽烟，不能开派对，十点以后请保持安静。邻居挺较真的。

lines.en: No problem. And where do we throw the rubbish? I don't want to __get it wrong__.
lines.zh: 没问题。垃圾扔哪儿？我不想弄错。

lines.en: There's a ==rubbish chute== in the corridor, right next to the lift. Recycling goes in the blue bin downstairs.
lines.zh: 走廊里有个垃圾槽，就在电梯旁边。可回收的放楼下的蓝色桶。

lines.en: **Perfect. I'll send you a message when we land.**
lines.zh: 好的。我们落地了给你发消息。

lines.en: Hi Daniel, sorry to bother you so late. We're at the door, but the code you sent isn't working.
lines.zh: Daniel 你好，抱歉这么晚打扰你。我们到门口了，但你发的密码打不开。

lines.en: Oh no, I'm so sorry. Which code did you try?
lines.zh: 哎呀，真不好意思。你试的是哪个密码？

lines.en: Four seven two nine. I've tried it three times, and the box won't open.
lines.zh: 四七二九。我试了三次，盒子就是打不开。

lines.en: Ah, my mistake. I ==reset== it this morning. The new code is eight one five three.
lines.zh: 啊，是我的错。我今天早上重设过了。新密码是八一五三。

lines.en: Hold on, let me try. Okay, it's open!
lines.zh: 等一下，我试试。好，开了！

lines.en: Sorry again for the ==hassle==. The Wi-Fi password is on the fridge.
lines.zh: 再次抱歉添麻烦了。Wi-Fi 密码贴在冰箱上。

lines.en: **No worries. One more thing. Would it be possible to check out a bit later on Monday?**
lines.zh: 没关系。还有一件事。周一能稍微晚点退房吗？

lines.en: The next guest arrives at three, so I can give you until one. Is that okay?
lines.zh: 下一位客人三点到，所以我可以给你们延到一点。可以吗？

lines.en: That works. Could we also __leave our luggage__ somewhere until the evening? Our flight is at night.
lines.zh: 可以。另外行李能找个地方放到傍晚吗？我们的航班是晚上的。

lines.en: Sure, you can leave it in the ==storeroom==. Just __drop the key__ back in the lockbox when you go.
lines.zh: 当然，可以放在储物间。走的时候把钥匙放回钥匙盒就行。

lines.en: Great. Thanks again, Daniel. Have a good night.
lines.zh: 好的。再次感谢，Daniel。晚安。

gist.q: 「你」怎么入住？房东答应提供什么？
gist.a: 自助入住，门边有密码钥匙盒，当天发密码；房东会提前装好婴儿床。

gist.q: 到了门口为什么打不开？最后怎么解决的？
gist.a: 房东早上重设了密码却没更新；他给了新密码八一五三，门就开了。

gist.q: 退房那天房东做了哪些通融？
gist.a: 下一位客人三点到，所以可以延到一点退房；行李可以放储物间到傍晚，走时把钥匙放回钥匙盒。

prompts.q: 入住第二天发现热水器没有热水，孩子等着洗澡。给房东打电话说明情况，问能不能尽快处理，以及今晚有没有临时办法。
prompts.ref: Hi Daniel, it's Lee from your Tiong Bahru apartment. Sorry to bother you, but there's no hot water in the bathroom. I've checked the switch, and it's on. Our son needs a bath before bed, so could someone come and take a look this evening? If not, is there anything I can try in the meantime?
prompts.ref_zh: 你好 Daniel，我是住你中峇鲁公寓的 Lee。不好意思打扰，浴室没有热水。我看过开关了，是开着的。我儿子睡前要洗澡，今晚能找人来看看吗？如果来不了，我先自己试试有什么办法？

prompts.q: 退房后到了机场，发现孩子的保温水壶落在公寓里了。给房东发语音，说明放在哪儿，问能不能帮忙寄到你家。
prompts.ref: Hi Daniel, it's Lee. We checked out this afternoon, but I think we left our son's water bottle behind. It's a small blue one, probably on the kitchen counter. Could you keep it for me when you go in? I'm happy to pay for a courier to send it to our place. Sorry for the trouble, and thanks for a great stay.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好 Daniel，我是 Lee。我们今天下午退房了，但好像把儿子的水壶落下了。是个蓝色的小水壶，大概在厨房台面上。你进去的时候能帮我收一下吗？我可以付快递费寄到我家。不好意思添麻烦，也谢谢你，住得很好。

words.ex: What time does your flight arrive?
The key is in a lockbox next to the front door.
Could the hotel put a cot in our room?
Please read the house rules before you check in.
Could you keep the noise down? The baby is sleeping.
Don't throw glass bottles down the rubbish chute.
I had to reset my password again.
Sorry for the hassle, and thanks for waiting.
You can leave your bags in the storeroom.
